text_block_list.text:
The talk is electric surrounding the
runners
participating in today's race.
Кинг Хало, famous
recently for riling up
the media, is no exception.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Moving to the waiting room of Yasuda
Kinen,
Кинг Хало proclaims it doesn't
matter who she has
to face in today's
race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She will break past any obstacle
standing in her
way and kick away the
competition. Her
enthusiasm is palpable
in light of today's
challenge.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
